parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
11:19 PM

Mummy ke birthday (Fri 23 Oct) ke liye 4 achhe options hain:

Rasmalai cake: mithai wala swaad, aur kaafi special lagta hai
Pineapple ya fresh fruit cake: halka aur kam meetha
Chocolate truffle: agar mummy ko chocolate pasand hai
Butterscotch: safe classic, sabko pasand aata hai

Parso ke liye aaj raat ya kal subah tak order kar do, taaki delivery time pakka mil jaye. Mummy ko kaunsa swaad zyada pasand hai, aur eggless chahiye?

Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
11:20 PM

No, Mon 2 Nov isn't a public holiday in Mumbai as far as I know, so banks and offices should be open. The nearest big one is Diwali, around Sun 8 Nov. Holiday lists can change, so check the official Maharashtra list if it matters for a bank visit.
